exposure: First trimester exposure to methyldopa therapy for chronic hypertension
cohort: The study included 261 pregnancies with first trimester exposure to methyldopa and 526 comparison pregnancies without chronic hypertension reported to the German Embryotox pharmacovigilance institute.
finding: The study found no significantly increased risk of major birth defects or early pregnancy loss with first-trimester methyldopa exposure, but it confirmed an increased risk of preterm birth and lower birth weight.
birth_weight: N/A (birth weight was measured as an outcome, not specified as an inclusion criterion for the babies)
gest_age: N/A (gestational age at birth, specifically preterm birth, was measured as an outcome, not specified as an inclusion criterion for the babies)
